_meta.indication: Dacogen is indicated for treatment of patients with myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS), including previously treated and untreated, de novo and secondary MDS of all FAB subtypes and intermediate-1, intermediate-2, and high-risk IPSS groups.

pivotal_trials.design: Open-label, multicenter, randomized, controlled trial of decitabine plus supportive care versus supportive care.
pivotal_trials.population: 170 adult patients with myelodysplastic syndromes of all FAB subtypes and IPSS High-Risk, Intermediate-2 and Intermediate-1 prognostic scores.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Two co-primary endpoints: overall response rate (complete or partial response) and time to progression to acute myeloid leukemia or death.
pivotal_trials.n: N=170 (89 randomized to Dacogen plus supportive care, 81 to supportive care).
pivotal_trials.result: Overall response rate (CR+PR) in the ITT population was 17% with Dacogen (CR 9%, PR 8%) versus 0% with supportive care (p<0.001); median duration of response 288 days. Time to progression to AML or death did not differ significantly (p=0.160).

key_safety: Most common adverse events were hematologic: neutropenia (90% vs 72%), thrombocytopenia (89% vs 79%), anemia (82% vs 74%), and febrile neutropenia (29% vs 6%); common nonhematologic events included pyrexia (53%) and hyperglycemia. 8 of 83 Dacogen-exposed patients discontinued for adverse events versus 1 of 81 on supportive care (83 of the 89 randomized patients were exposed to Dacogen).
target_moa: Decitabine is incorporated into DNA after phosphorylation and inhibits DNA methyltransferase, causing hypomethylation of DNA and cellular differentiation or apoptosis; it is also cytotoxic as an S-phase specific agent.

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee meeting; the application was not presented to the Oncology Drugs Advisory Committee.

description.text: Added an alternate dose regimen for treatment of patients with myelodysplastic syndromes

citations.quote: This “Prior Approval” supplemental new drug application provides for the use of an alternate dose regimen for the treatment of patients with myelodysplastic syndromes.

summary.text: Dacogen received full (traditional) approval as a 505(b)(2) NDA for myelodysplastic syndromes; approval followed a Complete Response to the Agency's prior August 31, 2005 approvable letter, and no Phase 4 commitments were required.

citations.quote: submitted pursuant to section 505(b)(2) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act for Dacogen™ (decitabine) for Injection 50 mg/vial.
The approval is recommended on the basis of a Complete Response by the sponsor to the approvable letter by the Agency.
The November 14, 2005 submission constituted a complete response to our August 31, 2005 action letter.
